raw_response:
I have farmed these 10.9 mu in Quzhou for 35 years. I never went to school, but I know this land and these crops with my own hands. My household has eight people, and some of my family work off-farm in town, so I must be careful with labor. I keep 6 mu in cotton because that is my main system and the cash income is reliable. The other 4.9 mu I plant winter wheat in autumn and follow with summer maize — the double crop keeps the family fed and the land busy.

Right now it is spring. My wheat is already in the field from last October. I rotary-tilled it before sowing, used an improved variety, and applied compound fertilizer as the base. This spring I will irrigate it two more times from my well — once at green-up and once at heading — and topdress with urea. I expect about 500 kg per mu at harvest in early June, God willing. As soon as the wheat comes off, I will plant hybrid maize seed directly without ploughing. There is no time to waste between crops, and no-tillage works fine if you clear the straw properly. The maize will need two irrigations and three sprays total — herbicide once and insecticide twice for the borers. I expect around 550 kg per mu.

For the 6 mu of cotton, I will rotary till in April and plant hybrid Bt cotton seed. Cotton demands more work, but I have the experience. I will put down compound fertilizer at planting and topdress again at flowering. From my well I will irrigate three times through the hot months. I will spray about eight times through the season — aphids, bollworms, and a bit of fungus if it turns humid. I know some people spray more, but eight times with good timing has been enough for me. I expect about 275 kg of seed cotton per mu. I do not have book learning, but I trust what my eyes have seen on this land, and I will do what has worked before.
